source.prices: Action Network, every book's current price (fetched 16:03)

markets.game: Johnny Walker vs Waldo Cortes Acosta

rules.arb: same game, market and line: the best price on each side at two different US books adds to under 100% implied; stake each side in proportion to its implied chance and both outcomes return the same
rules.middle: two numbers on one game at two books; both bets win if the result lands between them. Chance from past final scores (NFL / college: games with a similar line; NBA / WNBA: normal; NHL: Poisson). Kept when the average result is 0 or better.
rules.bonus: a bonus bet returns only its profit: bonus B at decimal price dX, cash B(dX-1)/dY on the other side keeps B(dX-1)(dY-1)/dY whatever happens
rules.fair: median of the books' no-vig chances at that line (multiplicative de-vig)
rules.clean: games not started; 0-15% vig per book; books more than 8 implied points from the other books' median dropped; no consensus, 'Open', in-play or alternate lines
